image_description: A close-up photograph of a brown butterfly, identified as a Ringlet (Aphantopus hyperantus), perched vertically on a green blade of grass. The wings are held closed, displaying the ventral side which is characterized by a warm brown color and distinct rows of eyespots (ocelli) with white pupils and black rings. The antennae are visible and appear clubbed. The background is a soft, out-of-focus green.
